Name: Leelo's Tortoiseshell Cat
Author: LeeloMods
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b][/center]


Adds a cute tortoiseshell cat to the game. This cat is based on my friend's cat, Cookie Dough, pictured below. This cat sprite comes with an adorable fluffy tail and slightly modified sprite animations. Hats are fully functional with this cat sprite!


[center][b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b][/center]


Download with a mod manager for automatic installation. For manual installation, download the .zip mod folder into the StardewValley\Mods folder, extract all from the .zip folder into the same filepath (StardewValley\Mods), and you are all set.

This cat sprite serves as a standalone option, but it is also part of mod bundle that comes with a brown tabby cat, an orange cow cat, and a tuxedo cat. See my other mod, Leelo's Cats, to view that bundle.

You do [b]not[/b] need to start a new game. The added cat can be adopted from the start or from Marnie's shop later on.

[color=#ff00ff]Remember to endorse the mod! This helps with visibility, allowing even more Stardew players to enjoy my content[/color]


[center][size=4][b]Meet the Model [/b][/size][/center]

[center][img width=400,height=400]https://i.imgur.com/5XyrNmJ.jpeg[/img]
Cookie Dough is a beautiful Persian cat with a tortoiseshell coat. She is one year old and has the energy and curiosity to prove it. Her human mom was moving houses so Cookie Dough has been temporarily living with my friend while her mom gets settled. Cookie Dough has quickly become a loved member of the family. She can often be found playing with Phoebe, the tuxedo cat. She loves playing with q-tips and causing trouble around the house.[/center]


[center][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]


Requires SMAPI and content patcher for full integration.
